title: Nourishing Crumbly Turkish Potato Kebabs
description: A romantic Turkish dish featuring russet potato, marinate, and satvik-friendly ingredients, perfect for a special occasion. This crumbly kebab is a cultured delight that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine grated potato, chopped onion, minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Thread the potato mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Traditionally, these kebabs are served with a side of tangy tzatziki sauce.
To make the tzatziki sauce, combine yogurt, cucumber, garlic, and dill in a bowl and mix well.
Refrigerate the sauce for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
